pr_description.body:
## Why

GMI previously led with taxonomy and admission machinery, leaving readers to infer what a theme meant, what a company connection established, and which source date or lifecycle qualified the claim. This implements the Chairman's resumed product-and-code mandate in the existing frontend and consolidates Paper into one canonical product system.

## What changes

- Lead theme research with a plain-language topic explanation, dated company/product evidence, explicit limits and a concrete next action.
- Add the searchable company-evidence route. Preserve all 371 microthemes, parent paths, Core/Extended and evidence filters, the full index, taxonomy tree, value-chain lens and coverage arithmetic.
- Preserve URL/history restoration, responsive mobile browsing, related-topic navigation, keyboard/focus behavior, copy success/denial handling and server-rendered/no-JS/malformed-payload fallbacks.
- Reuse the existing theme, language, navigation and Brain owners. The original Brain root retains its palette, events and focus lifecycle; styling uses canonical tokens.
- Restrict public product rendering to the single separately cleared Micron observation, whose source was published on 26 February 2024, including its receipt, planned lifecycle, product/platform, source identity and visible EN/ZH attribution. ACCEPT/RATIFIED alone does not admit a new public fact.
- Exclude private graph/correction/raw-source context from Jinja, retire stale issuer output after withdrawal and refuse nonregular/symlink issuer targets.
- Preserve missing, unknown or malformed knowledge dates as not recorded in EN/ZH; source publication and Planned lifecycle remain independent. Valid recorded first-seen dates retain their existing display.
- Include generated pages, incumbent GMI CI registration, production-render regression tests, dated browser evidence and editable Paper workflow/build views.
- Bring the full index directly to search with one title/date, a 44 px Clear search action, coherent filtered counts, and a mobile Category + Go control that preserves research context and repeat navigation.

The canonical design home is [GMI Explorer · Product system](https://app.paper.design/file/01M5H6EARN9YHQV17JC6ZG9BRY/p-1-0). Start index work on [Index · Search and navigation](https://app.paper.design/file/01M5H6EARN9YHQV17JC6ZG9BRY/p-8-0); the [source receipt page and 14-module Build](https://app.paper.design/file/01M5H6EARN9YHQV17JC6ZG9BRY/p-7-0) carry the current interaction/source contracts. Original product views and historical references remain preserved; the dated ten-board evidence below describes the earlier product set.

## Current source and focused verification — 9 November 2026

Current head: [`9bdc486c6b7622d9f306d29e9d12d572ed88415c`](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/Macro/commit/9bdc486c6b7622d9f306d29e9d12d572ed88415c). The PR remains **Draft and unmerged**, with the release/model holds below unchanged.

The latest change replaces the mobile index's off-screen category chip choices with a native **Category / 类别** select and explicit **Go / 前往**. Selection/typeahead only chooses a pending destination; Go uses the existing validated anchor, keeps the destination for repeat jumps and preserves query, lens, return and history. Available empty categories remain destinations. Filtering, locale changes, stale targets and 640/641 px focus transitions share the current owners. Desktop and no-JavaScript users retain the original links.

| Evidence | Exact scope |
|---|---|
| Latest category/navigation matrix | **24 cases / 24 fresh anonymous contexts**, Chrome157.0.8103.39, zero page errors; six mobile states, two responsive, two without IntersectionObserver, four actually without JavaScript, six existing filtered-index, two Clear and two persistent-status cases |
| Real interaction and layout | Native click/Enter/Space, EN typeahead, repeated Go, last empty category, six stale link/group conditions, locale/count updates and focus recovery; 44 px controls, 61 px sticky strip, no horizontal overflow; six new phone captures inspected |
| Production renderer and source | 48 checked inputs and the existing accepted e644fa48… model; exact parent reproduction; rendered output changes are limited to index HTML and paired JS/CSS, with all six other HTML pages byte-identical; all ten changed files published and read back exactly |
| Earlier compact header at `20179e31` | 23 cases, 66 matched layouts, 145.98–233.89 px less space before search; one title/date, complete returns and the existing Brain reservation. These are retained dated measurements |
| Earlier Clear action at `16a87f43` | 36 cases / 42 fresh contexts covering tree/index activation, filtering, locale, focus, URL and native fallback. Earlier evidence remains tied to its recorded source |
| Paper readback | EN390 Day default and ZH320 Noir filtered/return states use the tested category contract; Build has 14 modules / 45 nodes, preserving prior IDs/styles outside the two replaced category components and four intentional source/proof text updates |

Read [DESIGN_RECORD §§11.19–11.29](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/Macro/blob/9bdc486c6b7622d9f306d29e9d12d572ed88415c/research/theme_graph/gmi_design_20261021/DESIGN_RECORD.md), [category validation](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/Macro/blob/9bdc486c6b7622d9f306d29e9d12d572ed88415c/research/theme_graph/gmi_design_20261021/CATEGORY_PICKER_VALIDATION_20261109.json), [header comparison](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/Macro/blob/20179e319a3f5219488fda4f1642a49e77ed8b13/research/theme_graph/gmi_design_20261021/INDEX_HEADER_VALIDATION_20261109.json) and [Clear validation](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/Macro/blob/16a87f43743fe3a9bae02db7e3d64969871d8cd9/research/theme_graph/gmi_design_20261021/SEARCH_CLEAR_VALIDATION_20261109.json). Two pre-browser harness syntax failures and the corrected successful run are retained explicitly.

These are exact-source rendering and anonymous component results. No current-head hosted CI, OS-native select popup, spoken assistive-technology, full shared shell/fonts, shared Brain runtime, live-account/public serving or deployment acceptance is asserted. The fixed 44 px Brain launcher and November9/20 clocks in the earlier header comparison are named fixtures.

## Release blocker — keep draft

**Keep Draft and all no-merge/no-Ready/no-un-draft/no-enqueue/no-relabel holds. No auto-merge or deployment is authorized while these holds remain.**

Original model run `gmi-product-upgrade-20261103-model01` remains **EFFECT_UNKNOWN / ROOT_UNVERIFIED**, with root `gmi-paper-makeover-20261103-sol`, parent `gmi-product-upgrade-20261103-sol`, original controller PID `38742` and lease `868f3981b9bd`. Its current status denies result consumption, retry and dispatch. No applicable settlement action is exposed; the original installed runtime owner must reconcile this same run/process/lease and publish eligible terminal evidence. This continuation has not consumed its result, reassigned its work or modified its fenced model/presentation/test paths.

The current product specimen does not grant broader source-emission rights, qualification, internal graph use or relationship publication. A qualified public-data projection remains with the incumbent owner. Release also requires concluded current-head CI and the protected deployment/live-verification path. The existing hourly observer reports attention facts only; it is not an engineering worker or release authority.

## Route integration and serving boundaries

Companies is integrated with the incumbent builder, normal render workflow, shared-document injection, standalone navigation and canonical/social metadata. This establishes the standalone GMI path. Parent Shared Shell catalogue admission remains with its existing cross-repository census/export owner; no derived catalogue rows were hand-added.

The existing GMI sitemap exclusion and `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, noarchive` remain intentional. Indexing promotion must coordinate the serving and sitemap owners. Changing access classification does not grant public-fact permission.


**Cross-PR catalogue integration remains owed:** [PR #10696 comment 6626264216](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/pull/10696#issuecomment-6626264216) records the earlier omitted companies route; the later November 4 source record below captures the exporter admission condition. These dated observations do not settle current consumer admission. The incumbent registry/export owner must qualify the exact combined source and original consumer-admission hold without inferring access or public-fact rights. Both source lanes touch registry tests; this writer does not take over the parallel owner branch.

## November 4 verification record — historical head

Recorded head: `be851458055efbffa1f2db61da12b7744502479a` (GMI source repair plus then-current main integration; Draft at that observation).

| Evidence | Result and scope |
|---|---|
| Existing eight-suite GMI CI command, executed locally on the candidate source | **186 passed in 109.89 seconds**, exit 0 |
| Bound source/data/template/test inputs | **130 checked**, no unexpected differences; two intended builder/test overrides for this repair |
| Knowledge-clock regression | **7 failures and 1 positive control reproduced before repair**; all eight cases now pass through the production renderer with EN/ZH tooltip and independent publication/lifecycle checks |
| Output-target symlink hardening | **9 reproduced failures → 9 green** for six fixed HTML pages, paired CSS/JS and site directory; disposable red test overwrote outside sentinel, corrected preflight refuses before any generated write |
| Attribution and public-boundary regression | Six altered-label cases, incomplete/unqualified facts, stale issuer retirement and symlink refusal remain covered |
| Same-input renderer comparison | **9/9 HTML/CSS/JS outputs byte-identical** for the accepted specimen |
| Accepted real Chrome browser proof | **92/92 passed**, zero recorded page exceptions; committed browser inputs unchanged |
| Accepted visual evidence | 91 original PNGs retained; accepted design work was not recaptured |
| GitHub publication readback | All four intended code/evidence blobs match; one commit ahead of the parent with no unexpected paths |
| Hosted CI observed November 4 | [CI 41898455221](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/actions/runs/41898455221) was **in progress** at the recorded integrated head; no completed hosted result was accepted in this observation |
| Hosted fences observed November 4 | [Fences 41898455029](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/actions/runs/41898455029) concluded **SUCCESS** at the recorded integrated head |


That November 4 continuation also guarded fixed GMI output targets. A controlled symlink test previously overwrote a disposable file outside the intended output directory. The new renderer refuses pre-existing output symlinks before its page and asset writes. All 186 GMI tests passed and all nine accepted specimen files remained byte-identical. This is not a claim of race-free filesystem hardening or a production incident. [Exact source-bound validation](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/blob/d6500a8398d11d717ca4af7015d557c61fb084b1/research/theme_graph/gmi_design_20261021/PUBLIC_OUTPUT_SYMLINK_VALIDATION_20261104.json).

The repair removes a confirmed fallback that displayed the source publication date as “first seen” when knowledge time was missing. Invalid KNOWN values previously either broke rendering or displayed an impossible date. The builder now validates the recorded clock and the tooltip displays “first seen not recorded” / “首次收录时间未记录” when needed. A valid known knowledge date stays distinct from the 26 February 2024 publication date. These new states are covered by production-render tests; the accepted browser matrix was preserved, not rerun.

The parent head `71d7124f6634c4080ad4d926826d4a24dd60b68b` passed [fences 41793928552](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/actions/runs/41793928552); its [CI 41793928668](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/actions/runs/41793928668) was still executing when last observed. The earlier integration head `f328fe875d48db8392533ff649271d687961219d` passed [CI 41777490547](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/actions/runs/41777490547) and [fences 41777490350](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/actions/runs/41777490350). Historical results do not substitute for current-head hosted checks.

The three S1 regressions introduced by withholding incomplete/unreviewed issuer pages remain repaired without weakening production admission.
